_doc: Model zoo data for aiegraph.model.ZOO and frontend/tvmrelay/deploy_flow (model names live here, not in the generic .py code). 'default' is the model used when none is given; 'module' is the stem of the generated <module>.c / <module>_graph.json / <module>_params.bin. The default is ImageNet v1 on purpose: post-activation, so BN folds into the preceding conv (deploy_flow.prefold_onnx). 'prototype_example' is a filled-in user-kernel backbone shown to the AI prototyper.
